text:
idk if I'm doing this right, but as u age, the things ur willing to tolerate...the go/no-go list…looks very different than from when u were younger.

the instant "no go" list is two categories

1. closed-mindedness, inability to accept that other viewpoints exist, mental rigidity

that's like 90% of people off the bat

Munger's quip that "You couldn't squeeze a dime between what they already know and what they will never learn."

2. the other "no go" is a hateful heart, envy, cruelty, and prejudice in all forms

I'm not even on some good-guy shit with this

its that these people are always broken and fucked up. they drag you down and they drain your energy

nothing to talk about left/right or race/religion

its not about any of these groups, its about that ur attitude sucks ass
 
all I can think is "how do u have so much hate in your heart" or "you could not possibly be further from God"

blaming others, when 100% of your problems are all because of the same person... the man in the mirror.

read any great man bio and you'll see they're on the other side of this trade

so those two combined, ur looking at 99.9% of people

--

the "go" list at this point, is anyone who is self-aware, humble, respectful, objective, and capable of critical thought

we might disagree on every single possible subject, but if u are propounding some unique worldview shaped by ur own experience and reading - and you can make me think differently - u are cool in my book

that, and the Godly man, who is the same regardless of religion

there are saintly traits to be desired which are universal -- love for your fellow man, equality, benevolence, forgiveness -- and they render you extremely pleasant to be around…one of many payoffs from Pascal’s wager 

--

that's the list as it stands today

I think 10-15 years ago it was prob "go: people who agree with my worldview" and "no-go: people who don't"

now I just don't care

the truth is always in the middle somewhere

and all good things stem from having a mind that flows like water, one that sees the world as it really is, free of preconceived beliefs and bias and emotion

this is core to any success in markets, in writing, and I suspect in most other fields

tribalism in all forms pushes u away from objective truth and towards groupthink + ideology. must be avoided. poisonous

like I said, I have zero clue if I'm doing this right

but most of it is driven by the realization that u can either be great, or u can "fit in”…but u cannot do both. 

so if u are aiming for the former, u gotta put distance between u and the crowd and protect ur independent thinking capabilities.

that's all I got at this juncture

keep hateful mf’s away from u. and if ur the afflicted one, u gotta get that hate out ur heart brotha, I’m telling u…it’s not how u want to be, and it will do nothing but prevent u from reaching ur goals.

“Life is better light on your feet” 🌅
